product_metadata.title: Toaster, Prime Rated Bread Toasters with Compact LED Display, Mirror Stainless Steel Toasters with 6 Shade Settings, Extra Wide Slots, Defrost/Reheat/Cancel, Removable Crumb Tray (4 Slice) 1
features: 🌟【𝑳𝑬𝑫 𝑪𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒕𝒅𝒐𝒘𝒏 𝑻𝒊𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝑫𝒊𝒔𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒚】: The bread toaster comes with a blue LED screen display indicating toasting progress, making it easy to see the baking gear and the remaining time about selected shade setting at a glance. Note 3 basic functions (defrost, reheat and cancel). Defrost mode plus 30 secs, reheat mode heat 30 secs on selected gear, and Cancel can stop toasting anytime.

🌟【1.5" 𝑬𝒙𝒕𝒓𝒂-𝑾𝒊𝒅𝒆 𝑺𝒍𝒐𝒕𝒔】: LOFTER 4 Slice Toaster measures 1.5" wide slots with adjusting guides, making it suitable for various bread types, such as thin waffles or thick artisanal bread, and always keep bread in best toasting position. It is also equipped with an automatic pop-up function when the food is done.

🌟【6 𝑩𝒓𝒐𝒘𝒏𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝑺𝒆𝒕𝒕𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔】: The Stainless Steel Toaster with 6 browning dials, enable you to decide the right degree of toasting, choosing from lightly golden to deep dark toasted slice from 1 (light) to 6 (dark) gear accommodated by individual preferences. heating wire on both sides of each slot toasts bread evenly and fast. enable you to decide the right degree of toasting for you.

🌟【𝑬𝒂𝒔𝒚 𝒕𝒐 𝑪𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒏 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝑺𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆】: Bread crumbs are collected in a removable tray at the bottom of the toaster, so just pull it out and clean the crumbs immediately(the tray can be washed directly)! It even has a fuss-free cord wrap underneath the toaster to manage unsightly power cords when finished using it.

🌟【100% 𝑺𝒂𝒇𝒆𝒕𝒚 & 𝑵𝒐 𝑹𝒊𝒔𝒌】: Built with high-end and durable stainless steel and multi-hole design on the bottom, the toaster guarantees a faster cooling speed. The toaster not only provides anti-overheat protection but also upgrades anti-leakage protection, greatly increasing security when making breakfast. Purchase it now by click "By now with 1-Click" or"Add to Cart".
